static_traits.name: 陈逸立
static_traits.family_status: 与父母一起在海边长大，without兄弟姐妹
static_traits.social_status: 有几位要好的朋友，但not容易敞开谈论Self-doubt；因自责与not接纳赞美，Interpersonal relationships有所紧张
static_traits.medical_history: deny既往心理治疗史；deny类似问题既往史；without明显躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能Reflection自身体验；略感紧张但配合度高；倾向use自我要求与自责的表述，难以接纳他人赞美

basic_info.main_problem: 我倾向于贬低自己在爱好和兴趣中的积极面，导致自我批评和Self-doubt。这些感受始于一年前烤蛋糕失败后将责任归咎于自己。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到Self-doubt和自我批评影响了我享受爱好的能力并损害了自尊，因此希望通过咨询得到帮助。
growth_experiences: 原生家庭与背景：与父母在海边长大，without兄弟姐妹。拥有几个可以谈心的朋友，但在表达Self-doubt方面感到困难。
关键转折事件（一年前）：烘焙时蛋糕烤糊，将失败归咎于自身能力not足，由此开始在爱好和兴趣中频繁出现自我批评与Self-doubt，特do not在烹饪、烘焙、DIY 等活动发生小失误后加重。

core_beliefs: My value depends on whether I achieve perfection in every aspect

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次做not好，就说明我not适合继续做这件事
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constraining oneself through self-criticism, and reducing or avoiding baking to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not该那么喜欢烘焙；我并not擅长这个

special_situations.event: 几天前尝试新菜谱但效果not佳
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能立刻把新菜谱做好，就说明我永远学not会
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 对自己设定更苛刻标准、追求完美，反复Reflection错误并自责
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough；我永远都not会做好烹饪

special_situations.event: Friends praising his works or performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人夸奖，多半只是客套或安慰，not能当真
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: deny或贬低正面反馈，减少与朋友的深入交流以避免尴尬
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是说好听话；我其实并have not做得好

special_situations.event: Encounters tasks at work that require creativity or relate to personal interests
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果作品not够出色，就会被他人negate，证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinates or avoids high-exposure creative tasks, or is excessively self-critical after completing them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果出错，大家会觉得我not专业；I will fail

core_conflict.wish: 被接纳与认可，即使not完美也能Freedom地享受兴趣爱好
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因not够好而被negate、羞辱或失去价值
defense_goal: 通过完美主义与自我批评来避免外界negate
与他人保持一定距离以减少暴露not完美的风险

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易失败的自我
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔或not真诚的他者（表面称赞、内心评判）

object_relations.self_representation: An individual needing to prove worth through performance
object_relations.object_representation: An authority/audience controlling evaluation and recognition

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others give positive feedback, praise, or normalize mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 对方只是在安慰我或敷衍，我其实做得并not好（移情：把过往被评判的经验Projection到当下）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 轻描淡写地回避赞美，use含糊词（比如“还好吧”），迅速转向缺点或错误。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请深入谈论Self-doubt与失败经历的情绪感受时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If exposing vulnerability will lead to being judged or looked down on (transference: treating others as picky judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以客观叙述替代情绪表达，语气平稳，use分析性语言回避情绪词。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about recent failures or small mistakes (such as a failed recipe)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The fault is mine; only by harshly pointing at myself can worse outcomes be prevented (transference: internalized critic)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Self-blaming statements increase, wording is harsh; if gently confronted, may respond with even stronger self-criticism.

manifestations: Introjection“必须在所有事情上都表现完美”的规则，感到被应当与必须束缚
Contracts choices and attempts in creative and hobby activities out of fear of failure
outcomes: 自我限制与回避，体验Freedom受限

manifestations: not易向朋友敞开谈Self-doubt，担心被评判
Suspicious of others' praise, believing it is just politeness, reducing genuine connection
outcomes: Strained and distant interpersonal relationships感增加
正向支持难以内化，Reinforcement负性自我图式

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以“必须/应该”自我要求（如认为“not该那么享受烘焙”）
Treating perfection as the only standard of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Slightly nervous and cautious in counseling, worried about exposing shortcomings and being judged

positive_force: 具备一定的Reflection与学习动机，愿意尝试问题解决与认知重构
Has several friends who can support (potential support resources)
Stays passionate about interest activities; willing to keep practicing and improving
能够识do not问题对自尊与生活的影响，已尝试正念与自我关怀
negative_force: Perfectionism and the mindset of equating mistakes with failure
Tends to devalue positive feedback and results; hard to internalize affirmation
读心化与预测失败，放大他人negate性评价的可能
Frequent self-blame and self-criticism, relying on external approval to evaluate self-worth
在挫折后出现回避与Withdrawal，导致兴趣与人际的负循环

target_behavior.behavior: 在兴趣与工作任务中出现失误后进行强烈自我批评与negate正向反馈
antecedent: Baking or cooking failures occur (such as a burnt cake, a failed new recipe)
Takes on creative tasks or tasks related to personal interests at work
target_behavior.core_reason: 完美主义信念与核心信念“I am not good enough”，将一次错误等同整体失败，并依赖他人评判确定自我价值
target_behavior.function: Escapes feelings of failure and shame, trying to gain a sense of control and assurance of improvement through self-blame
target_behavior.consequence: 降低对爱好的享受与坚持，损害自尊，影响工作表现与Interpersonal relationships

target_behavior.behavior: 在Self-doubt后Avoids socializing或与朋友保持距离
antecedent: Receiving praise but doubting its sincerity
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕暴露not完美被评判，将他人视为潜在的挑剔者
target_behavior.function: 逃避被negate的可能与由此带来的情绪not适
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension、支持系统利用not足，Loneliness感与Self-doubt worsens
